description: Scrape PGA Tour, Korn Ferry Tour, PGA Tour Champions and PGA Tour Americas schedules, full-tournament leaderboards and round-by-round scores.

containsKeyword.description: Only keep rows whose tournament, player, team or course name contains this text.
containsKeyword.title: Keyword filter

maxPosition.description: Leaderboard / rounds mode: keep players or teams at or above this position (ties like T5 count as 5).
maxPosition.title: Max leaderboard position

maxResults.description: Page size: hard cap on records emitted by this run.
maxResults.title: Max results

mode.description: What to fetch: a season schedule, one leaderboard row per player/team, or one row per player/team per round.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy. The public PGA Tour API does not require one; it is used only if the API blocks the datacenter IP.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

roundNumber.description: Rounds mode only: keep a single round (1-8). Empty = every played round.
roundNumber.title: Round number

seasons.description: One or more season years for schedule mode (2012-2030; PGA Tour data starts in 2012, Korn Ferry/Champions in 2013, Americas in 2024). Empty = use the legacy season input or 2026.
seasons.title: Seasons

startIndex.description: Skip this many matching records before emitting the page. Use with Max results for pagination.
startIndex.title: Start index (pagination)

tour.description: Which tour to scrape. Schedules and leaderboards are available for all four tours.
tour.title: Tour

tournamentIds.description: Tournament IDs (e.g. R2026006) or pgatour.com leaderboard URLs for leaderboard / rounds mode. Up to 50; the legacy single tournamentId is accepted too.
tournamentIds.title: Tournament IDs or URLs

tournamentStatus.description: Only keep tournaments with these statuses (COMPLETED, IN_PROGRESS, UPCOMING; case-insensitive). Empty = any status.
tournamentStatus.title: Tournament status

title: PGA Tour Scraper Input
